description: She wears a fully opaque, floor-length ivory gown with a high rounded neckline, long sleeves, fitted waist and softly gathered skirt. Gold embroidered vertical bands run down the bodice and skirt, with matching embroidery at neckline, cuffs and lower hem. A broad gold ornamental belt set with oval red-purple stones encircles the waist. A long deep plum mantle with gold geometric and floral borders drapes over both shoulders and arms, falling beside the skirt. Dark bronze-brown closed shoes show beneath the hem, and her hands are held together in front.
